title: Always U™ work uniforms: A new standard for active teams
summary: Discover UniFirst's Always U™ work uniforms with 10-12% more stretch. Outfit active teams in uniforms reimagined to move the way they work.
body_markdown:
Always U™ work uniforms represent a deliberate choice by UniFirst to reimagine traditional work apparel for the next stage of the modern workforce. Purpose-built specifically for value-conscious businesses with active teams, this collection addresses a clear, long-standing market demand: premium stretch uniforms delivered at a budget-friendly price point for managed uniform rental programs. Engineered with 10%–12% more mechanical stretch than standard uniforms, Always U becomes a functional tool and the uniform your team will actually want to wear shift after shift.


## Table of Contents


Every generation of the workforce pushes industry standards forward, and today’s active teams require work uniforms that match their output. For active employees whose shifts involve continuous movement, bending, and lifting, a uniform should serve as an asset to help them with productivity. At UniFirst, we wanted to challenge the old boundaries of standard work apparel, refresh and really revolutionize it for the next stage of the modern workforce. This vision is the exact reason why Always U was created. By pairing direct customer insight with purpose-built design, we developed a collection that satisfies two critical organizational needs simultaneously: unmatched mobility and a budget-friendly price built specifically for a managed uniform rental program. Delivering 10%–12% more stretch than standard workwear, this collection establishes an accessible, professional standard that supports the productivity active teams while being economical for your uniform rental program.


##### Key takeaways


Always U work uniforms is a collection for active teams built around movement and natural mobility with a modern, professional appearance at a budget friendly price.


Purpose-built poly/cotton fabrics with mechanical stretch deliver 10–12% more stretch than standard work uniforms for all-day comfort and full range of motion.


A dedicated line of women’s work uniforms made to fit a woman's natural profile, not just an adaptation of the men’s collection.


Always U delivers comfort and fit which connect directly to productivity, improved morale, and increased employee retention.


Uncompromising value, closing a real market gap by delivering stretch, mobility, comfort, and style at a budget-friendly price point optimized for your uniform rental program.

## How do uniforms affect employee performance?


In standard value-tier programs, uniform design has historically prioritized fabric longevity over active flexibility. While structural durability remains foundational, rigid materials can create subtle resistance over a 10- or 12-hour shift. That discomfort can add up: more fatigue, less focus, and a slow drag on productivity.


Here’s the part leaders often miss. Your uniform program touches every employee, every shift, every day. Few other investments reach your entire workforce that consistently. When a uniform program actively supports the physical comfort of your teams, the positive impacts ripple across the entire organization boosting employee satisfaction scores, helping increase productivity, and stabilizing the retention numbers that matter to HR leaders. Stretch workwear with modern, comfortable styles have existed for a while, of course. The trouble is they’ve usually been too costly or impractical for a rental program. That’s the gap Always U was built to close.


## What is different in the Always U workwear collection?


Always U is workwear for active workers, reimagined from the ground up and engineered around how teams move, not how a uniform looks hanging on a rack. Put simply, it’s the uniform your team will actually want to wear.


We didn’t start with the fabric. We started with the worker: the technician sliding under a lift, the tradesperson on their feet for ten hours, the warehouse crew loading and unloading all day long. Then we purpose-built a collection of comfortable workwear that supports every one of those movements, from the first task of the morning to the last.


The result gives value-conscious businesses something they do not have to compromise on: comfort, modern style, function, and value in a single uniform program. And because it’s designed by the uniform experts at UniFirst, every stitch is backed by decades of hard-won industry expertise and the service integrity that keeps our customers with us for the long haul.


###### ALL-DAY COMFORT


Your people wear these garments for eight, 10, sometimes 12 hours at a time. As they move and stretch to do their work, they need to be comfortable to stay focused and productive. To deliver that, Always U uses poly/cotton fabrics with 10–12% more stretch, internal waistband features, integrated crotch gussets, and articulated knees. In plain terms: stretch work uniforms that move with you when you bend and squat, so nothing pulls, binds, or gets in the way.


###### UNRESTRICTED MOBILITY


Active work demands full range of motion. Always U work uniforms are purpose-built to move with your team, not against them. Every design choice from the fabric to the construction supports natural movement so workers can reach, twist, and lift freely without a second thought about what they’re wearing. That’s what comfortable workwear should do: disappear into the workday so your team can focus on the job at hand.


###### MODERN, PROFESSIONAL DESIGN


A uniform should make your team look as capable as they are. Always U brings clean, modern, professional work uniforms that fit the way today’s active teams work with tucked or untucked wearability built into the design. Your crew looks sharp and put-together, your customers see a team they can trust, and your business shows up looking like the operation you’ve worked hard to build.


###### UNCOMPROMISING VALUE


Here’s the part that matters to your budget: you don’t have to choose between quality and cost. Always U delivers high-quality, purpose-built, durable stretch workwear designed specifically for value-conscious businesses. Real features, real durability, real value with no trade-offs required. And with a UniFirst rental program behind it, work uniforms are inspected, maintained, and replaced as needed, so that professional appearance holds up week after week.

## Work uniforms built for the women on your team


According to the[U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics](https://www.bls.gov/news.release/empsit.t21.htm) , women now make up 14.3% of the construction workforce and 28.6% of all manufacturing employees. That’s more than 4.8 million women working across two of the most active, physical industries in the country. The demand for work uniforms built around women’s fit coupled with mobility isn’t a future consideration. It’s an immediate one. When every member of your team has a uniform that truly fits, everyone feels it and everyone performs a little better for it.

Women have been an essential part of active workforces for a long time. However, their uniforms haven’t always reflected that. Always U changes the story with a dedicated line of women’s work uniforms designed around women’s fit and function from the very start. These are not adapted from a men’s pattern after the fact. Women’s shirts feature waist shaping and hem lengths cut to a woman’s natural profile. Pants and shorts offer a contoured mid-rise fit, lay-flat pockets, and streamlined storage that adds real utility without extra bulk.


## Why comfortable work uniforms drive better business results


This isn’t just about softer fabric and smarter pockets. Comfort and fit connect directly to the outcomes you care about most. The ones that show up on your dashboards and in your team’s daily experience.


**What the research suggests:**


In a peer-reviewed study of 2,560 uniform wearers, researchers found that employees perceived their uniforms as having a meaningful impact on their happiness and behavior at work with comfort, fit, and practicality emerging as key factors linked to productivity. ([Moody, L., Journal of Fashion Marketing and Management, 2023](https://doi.org/10.1108/JFMM-09-2021-0223) ).


##### Studies have found


Employees feel uniforms have a meaningful impact on their happiness and behavior at work.


It’s a finding that aligns with what many operations and HR leaders already see on the floor: when people feel good in what they’re wearing, they show up differently.


**Consider the ripple effect:**


- When workers are comfortable, they stay focused and focus drives productivity across the floor.
- When people feel good in what they wear, morale rises and satisfaction scores tend to follow.
- When your team looks professional and feels respected, they’re more likely to stay, improving retention.


That last point matters more than ever. Replacing a single frontline worker can cost thousands in recruiting, onboarding, and lost output. A uniform your people are glad to put on is a small, daily signal of respect and small signals add up. For HR, that’s an investment in satisfaction and retention. For operations, it’s a productivity advantage on active teams. For procurement, it’s a trusted, cost-effective choice that delivers long-term value. One program, three wins.


## Reimagine your team’s uniform


Your team shows up and gives it everything they’ve got. Their work uniforms should do the same.


Always U is more than a new product announcement. It’s a new standard for what a work uniform can be. All-day comfort. Freedom to move. A professional appearance your team wears with pride. Purpose-built function for both the men and women who power your operation. And dependable value your business can stand behind, whether you’re outfitting a busy manufacturing floor, warehouse, or auto shop.


If you’re planning for the year ahead, tackling a turnover challenge, or simply tired of uniforms that do not move the way you work, this is where to start.


Ready to see the difference?[Discover the Always U collection](https://unifirst.com/uniforms-workwear/always-u/) orrequest a sample to find out how you can reimagine your team’s uniform.
